question: The focal length of a convex mirror is 15 cm. Following New Cartesian Sign Convention, its centre of curvature is located at:
solution:
The correct answer is **__30 cm__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **New Cartesian Sign Convention**

 
 
• **​**To avoid confusion when interpreting the** ray directions**, the New Cartesian Sign Convention is utilized. Take a look at the diagram for a clear understanding.

 
 
• The **optical center** of the lens is taken into account when measuring all distances.
 
• **Negative distances** are those that are measured in the **opposite direction** of the **incident light.**
 
• **Positive distances **are those that are measured in the **same direction** as the** incident light.**
 
• **Positive heights** are those that are measured **upwards and perpendicular** to the** principal axis.**
 
• **Negative heights** are those that are measured **downward and perpendicular** to the **principal axis.**
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6344b9ef1a9c7f3ba71d6227a1d50c57f129a3063b426a29f2d6767c8cf8fac.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Focal length** 

 
 
• ​The focal length of a mirror or lens is the distance between its** focal point and its pole**, also known as the optical center of the lens.
 
• After reflecting in the mirror, a parallel beam of light is** "focused" **at the focal point (F) of the device.
 
• In the case of a** convex mirror and lens**, the focal length is regarded as **positive.**
 
• It is considered a** negative** for a **concave mirror and lens.**
 
• Relation between F and C is **F=2C.**
